_comment: Single source of truth for the SDK's subpaths and the dependency rules between them (design doc §C1 'Dependency rules'). The exports map, ESLint boundaries, dependency-cruiser and the Module Federation shared list are all generated from this file. `imports` lists the subpaths each one may import; '*' means any subpath. Layers are documentation only. `area` groups the subpaths by function (docs/areas/); it documents ownership and changes no rule.

areas.title: Foundation
areas.summary: Page identity, consent, session id, runtime config and the RFC 9457 error model: what every other area stands on.

areas.title: Observability
areas.summary: Traces, logs and metrics over OTLP to /otel, correlated, redacted and consent-gated, with the platform registry's rules.

areas.title: Data access
areas.summary: The ApiClient: route templates, correlation headers, retries, 401 refresh, de-duplication and problems.

areas.title: Identity & access
areas.summary: Keycloak sign-in, workspaces and sessions, UI permissions, and per-tenant browser storage.

areas.title: Micro-frontend platform
areas.summary: Loading remotes, kill switches and feature flags, cross-app navigation, new-version detection.

areas.title: UI support
areas.summary: Translations, locale and direction, formatting; HTML sanitizing and the Trusted Types policy.

areas.title: Developer surface
areas.summary: React hooks, providers and error boundaries over every area, and the test kit.

packageImports._comment: Third-party packages restricted to specific subpaths (design doc §C1). Any subpath not listed may not import them.
